snippet.title: ECHO SEQUENCE - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Every death leaves an Echo. 
Wishlist ECHO SEQUENCE on Steam. 
👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/5362750?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce

Every death leaves an Echo: a hologram of your last life that replays every step and every shot beside you. Die on purpose, let your past selves hold the plates and guard the cart, and take on the undead as a squad of one in this top-down roguelite shooter.

🔁 Time-loop co-op with yourself: every loop you spend fights beside you as an Echo
🧩 Split the work across your lives: plates, carts and bosses no single soldier can handle alone
🧟 The undead hunt your Echoes too, and brutes throw crates, barrels and other zombies into your line
🔥 Barrels burn and explode, fire spreads, cover breaks apart
⬆️ Upgrades between levels, and new weapons unlocked between runs

Single-player · PC (Steam) · Full controller support

Wishlist and follow on Steam: [STEAM PAGE LINK]

#EchoSequence #IndieGame #Roguelite
